channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Reflections: Of choir robes, swing sets
item.description: We commit to scripture, then to prayer. But we also listen to one another and try to find consensus.

item.title: OPINION: Shrinking inconvenience
item.description: Cities in Shelby County are making an effort to reduce the inconveniences caused by trains. These projects aim to improve the flow of traffic and public safety while prioritizing progress in the community.

item.title: American Legion hosts Oratorical Contest
item.description: The American Legion Matthew Blount Post 555, in partnership with American Legion Auxiliary Unit 555, hosted the Shelby County Area High School Oratorical Contest at the Pelham City Council Chambers on Saturday, Feb. 7.

item.title: 9 Things to Consider when Choosing an Eco-friendly Car in 2026
item.description: The automotive landscape has transformed dramatically, with eco-friendly vehicles no longer representing a niche market but rather the mainstream choice for conscious consumers.

item.title: Pelham wins Lakeshore Shootout Gold Division with three victories
item.description: Pelham won the Lakeshore Shootout Gold Division while beating Thompson in their first meeting in five years and finally avenging their playoff loss to Northridge.

item.title: Six county athletes claim first at South Sectionals
item.description: Spain Park, Chelsea, Pelham, Montevallo and Shelby County athletes claimed South Sectional titles while the Panthers and Bulldogs took top-three finishes in the team standings.

item.title: Oak Mountain, Thompson take top two spots at 7A North Sectionals
item.description: Oak Mountain won the 7A North Sectional team title with Thompson taking runner-up honors as athletes from both teams joined Calera’s Cole Massey as individual champions.

item.title: Calera wins first area title since 2018, beats Benjamin Russell
item.description: Calera won its first girls basketball area title since 2018 after pulling away from Benjamin Russell on the road.

item.title: Spain Park overcomes slow start to beat Helena, advance to sub-regionals
item.description: Spain Park rallied to pull away from Helena and advance to sub-regionals and an area title game with Pelham.

item.title: Pelham makes sub-regionals, beats Chelsea behind Morrissette’s 29
item.description: Pelham rode a dominant defensive performance and 29 points from Daeshaun Morrissette to beat Chelsea, advance to sub-regionals and set up a trilogy match with Spain Park for the area title.
